PullRequest.Title: agentHost: clarify restricted telemetry boundary regressions
PullRequest.Body:

Make the restricted-telemetry forwarding boundary explicit in regression test names and assertions. Test-only follow-up to microsoft/vscode#346400 and microsoft/vscode#346441.

- Verify restricted SDK notifications never enter either generic forwarding entry point, even when restricted telemetry is enabled. Previously, the host test could pass if the final sink alone discarded them.
- Add independently named restricted-only and compaction rejection cases.
- Make the response-ordering tests state that filtering must preserve the standard response's owning turn.
- Keep positive assertions for standard forwarding and dedicated restricted routes, and wait for delivery signals before checking destinations.

No production behavior changes.

## Validation

Validated on Windows with Node 24.22.1 and pnpm 12.16.0:

- `pnpm run build-fast --client-only` - passed.
- `pnpm run typecheck-client` - passed.
- `pnpm run eslint src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotGitHubTelemetryForwarder.test.ts` - passed.
- `.\scripts\test.bat src\vs\platform\agentHost\test\node\copilotAgent.test.ts src\vs\platform\agentHost\test\node\copilotGitHubTelemetryForwarder.test.ts src\vs\platform\agentHost\test\node\agentHostGitHubTelemetryRouter.test.ts` - passed, 1,084 tests.
- `pnpm run test-node --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotAgent.test.ts` - passed, 1,051 tests.
- `pnpm run test-node --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/copilotGitHubTelemetryForwarder.test.ts` - passed, 23 tests.
- `pnpm run test-node --run src/vs/platform/agentHost/test/node/agentHostGitHubTelemetryRouter.test.ts` - passed, 12 tests.

Regression sensitivity was checked separately:

- Temporarily removing the dispatcher guard made the host boundary test fail because restricted notifications reached the generic forwarding entry points.
- Temporarily removing the two sink guards made 10 forwarder tests fail, including the independent restricted-only and compaction rejection cases.
- All guards were restored before the final build and passing suite runs. No production changes are included.

Scenarios.Scenario: Agent Host routes restricted and standard SDK telemetry while restricted telemetry is enabled
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The test invokes the SDK telemetry callback, which updates in-memory context, routes restricted target events through the dedicated router, rejects other restricted events at _forwardGitHubTelemetry, and synchronously records standard generic/compaction events in the test telemetry service. Deferred promises only wait for already-required delivery signals; all loop iterations are serial and fixed.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Construct the existing Agent Host test fixture with an in-memory SQLite database
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One fixture database per test, unchanged from the pre-diff version of this same test
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The test already constructed the same Agent Host fixture and in-memory database before this diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Fixture construction precedes telemetry assertions; the added notifications do not perform database operations.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: A fixed matrix of 6 generic kinds and 2 compaction kinds, each sent once as restricted and once as standard, plus two route-specific events. Cardinality is 18 notifications with no user-controlled collection or history scaling.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One notification at a time because each callback invocation is awaited; there is no Promise.all, queue burst, subprocess concurrency, or network concurrency.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Restricted context resolution uses the test service's in-memory Map. The test does not alter production cache keys, misses, invalidation, coalescing, or warm/cold behavior.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed loop bounds, sequential awaits, mocks, and forwarding implementations were traced directly.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact test-runner overhead varies by platform, but the added work is a small fixed number of in-memory callbacks and array appends.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff broadens fixed-cardinality regression coverage without adding production work, external I/O, unbounded allocation, or concurrent fan-out.

Scenarios.Scenario: Generic telemetry sink rejects restricted regular and compaction notifications
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each generated unit test constructs an in-memory TestTelemetryService and CopilotGitHubTelemetryForwarder, calls forward or forwardCompaction directly, and returns at the restricted guard before data spreading or telemetry publication.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Five fixed test cases: 3 generic event kinds and 2 compaction event kinds.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous and serial under the test runner; no asynchronous scheduling or shared queue.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No cache is read or populated.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the direct callees immediately return on restricted notifications.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Only framework per-test setup overhead is environment-dependent; no expensive application boundary is reached.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Splitting coverage into five fixed tests adds negligible test-only work and verifies an early-return path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Response telemetry preserves owning-turn correlation after a restricted copy
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The existing asynchronous test sends a restricted response followed by its standard copy and waits for one in-memory recording signal. The diff changes the test name and includes the already-present restricted field in the assertion projection.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: A fixed 2 response kinds by 2 initiator kinds matrix, unchanged from before the diff.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Each generated test waits for one delivery signal; no changed concurrency.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the diff changes assertions only on this path.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material; the only additional operation is reading one object property per recorded event.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression because execution cardinality and production behavior are unchanged.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed both changed test files and every diff hunk, then traced the exercised Agent Host routing and telemetry sink implementations plus test mocks. The PR contains no production changes; added work is fixed-cardinality, in-memory test coverage with serial execution and no new external boundary, retention, or scaling mechanism.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
